technical.title: WorldLeague Benchmark Evaluates Physical Agency and Robot Tasks
technical.summary: WorldLeague is a new benchmark that compares AI systems across 60 simulated robot tasks, measuring physical goal progress through perception, memory, planning, and action.
technical.why: It provides a standardized way to evaluate autonomous robot manipulation and perception capabilities.

technical.title: Embo-Harness Framework Systematically Studies Frontier-Model-as-Policy Robotic Loops
technical.summary: Embo-Harness investigates prompting, planning, action execution, and tool use in robotic agentic loops, distilling six empirical findings into a practical design recipe.
technical.why: Understanding frontier-model harnesses helps engineers improve closed-loop robotic control and deployment.

technical.title: Short Chain-of-Thought Can Disrupt Spatial Vision-Language Model Answers
technical.summary: Research across 15 open and 6 closed vision-language models shows that short chain-of-thought turns perception into transcription, causing answers to follow written spatial relations instead of images.
technical.why: This insight helps computer vision engineers troubleshoot spatial reasoning failures in multimodal models.
